support.text: Alice and Bob got married on April 5th, 2012. Alice and Bob have a son, Charlie, who was born on September 16th, 2017. Alice and Charlie live in a home maintained by Alice since September 16th, 2017. Alice is entitled to a deduction for Charlie under section 151(c) for the years 2017 to 2019. Alice and Bob file a joint return for the years 2017 to 2019.
